character_response_concept:tsundere.text: Character-response concept meaning: A guarded, rejecting, or distancing surface toward a specific counterpart is contradicted by a minimized or involuntary sign of positive affiliation toward that same counterpart. The contradiction, shared relationship target, and concealment failure define the concept; no particular gaze, facial geometry, pose, role, or prop is required. en label: a guarded, rejecting, or distancing surface toward one counterpart contradicted by a minimized or involuntary sign of positive affiliation toward that same counterpart. ko label: 특정 상대에게 퉁명스럽거나 거리를 두지만 같은 상대에 대한 숨은 호감이 비의도적이거나 억제된 반응으로 드러나는 츤데레. ja label: 特定の相手にそっけなく距離を置きながら、同じ相手への好意が無意識または抑えた反応として漏れるツンデレ. aliases: 츤데레, ツンデレ, tsundere. semantic relations: surface_affect contrasts with underlying_affiliation; same relationship target for relationship_target, primary_action, affect_leak; surface_affect precedes or coexists before affect_leak. optional manifestations: an authored delay between a relationship trigger and an observable prosocial response; a rule requiring descriptive behavior axes and rejecting appearance-based, abusive, clinical, or cross-locale archetype shortcuts; a deliberate separation between displayed response and one restrained leakage cue of underlying positive affect; supportive positioning that preserves consent and autonomy rather than restraining or possessing the counterpart; a small context-specific relaxation or care action directed toward an identified trusted counterpart. paraphrases: 퉁명스럽게 말하면서도 다친 동료를 계속 챙기고 그 반응을 몰래 확인한다; 같은 상대를 밀어내는 태도와 숨길 수 없는 호감의 흔적이 동시에 드러난다; 차갑게 선을 긋지만 행동은 같은 상대를 보호하고 애정 표현은 곧바로 축소한다; She keeps helping the same counterpart while dismissing any suggestion that she cares.; A rejecting surface gives way to one minimized sign of positive affiliation toward the same person.; 冷たく振る舞いながら同じ相手への気遣いが漏れ、その好意をすぐに隠そうとする; 同じ相手への気遣い; 好意が漏れる; 好意を隠す.

character_response_confounder:tsundere:p.text: Character-response confounder meaning: The surface is hostile and no positive affiliation toward the same counterpart becomes observable. en label: pure hostility toward the counterpart with no observable positive affiliation. ko label: 같은 상대에 대한 호감이나 배려 없이 미워하고 위협하며 화만 내는 순수한 적대. ja label: 同じ相手への好意や気遣いがなく、憎み脅すだけの純粋な敵意. aliases: pure hostility, 순수한 적대, 純粋な敵意. paraphrases: 상대를 미워해서 위협하고 계속 화만 낸다; no positive affiliation, only hostility toward the target; 相手を憎んで脅すだけで好意はない.

character_response_confounder:tsundere:g.text: Character-response confounder meaning: The character merely avoids attention without active guardedness or a denial-versus-affiliation contradiction. en label: generic shyness without a denial-versus-affiliation contradiction. ko label: 거절과 숨은 호감의 대비 없이 그저 수줍어서 시선을 피하는 일반적인 소심함. ja label: 拒絶と隠れた好意の対比がなく、ただ恥ずかしくて避ける一般的な内気さ. aliases: generic shyness, 일반적인 소심함, 一般的な内気さ. paraphrases: 그저 수줍어서 관심을 피한다; merely shy without a guarded contradiction; ただ恥ずかしくて注目を避ける.

Character-response confounder meaning: A helpful act is openly warm and has no guarded or rejecting surface to contradict. en label: generic open kindness with no guarded or rejecting surface. ko label: 누구에게나 공개적으로 상냥하고 친절하여 감정 대비가 없는 일반적 호의. ja label: そっけない表面や拒絶がなく、誰にでも素直に優しい一般的な親切. aliases: generic kindness, 일반적 호의, 一般的な親切. paraphrases: 누구에게나 상냥하고 공개적으로 친절하다; open kindness without a guarded surface; 誰にでも素直に優しくする.

character_response_confounder:tsundere:r.text: Character-response confounder meaning: The behavior is fully explained by routine professional or service duty rather than concealed affiliation. en label: routine professional service explained only by role duty. ko label: 숨은 호감이 아니라 직업적 의무만으로 설명되는 일상적 서비스 행동. ja label: 隠れた好意ではなく職務上の義務だけで説明できる日常的なサービス. aliases: role-only service, composed professional with no relationship-specific care, 직업적 의무, 관계 행동 없는 무표정한 전문가, 職務上の義務. paraphrases: 직원으로서 일상적인 서비스를 한다; 침착하게 혼자 일하지만 특정 상대를 위한 행동은 없는 무표정한 전문가; routine professional duty only; an expressionless expert works alone with no action for a specific counterpart; 職員として通常のサービスをする.

character_response_confounder:tsundere:o.text: Character-response confounder meaning: Positive affiliation is deliberately and openly expressed from the start. en label: open affection expressed from the start without concealment or denial. ko label: 감추거나 부정하지 않고 처음부터 호감을 공개적으로 표현하는 애정. ja label: 隠したり否定したりせず最初から好意を素直に示す愛情. aliases: open affection, 공개적인 애정, 素直な愛情. paraphrases: 처음부터 호감을 숨기지 않고 표현한다; open affection from the start; 最初から好意を隠さず示す.

character_response_confounder:tsundere:p.text: Character-response confounder meaning: Control, surveillance, coercion, or possessiveness replaces prosocial affiliation and concealment failure. en label: possessive obsession centered on surveillance, control, coercion, or ownership. ko label: 배려보다 감시 통제 강요 소유욕이 앞서는 집착적 관계. ja label: 思いやりではなく監視、支配、強要、独占欲が中心の執着関係. aliases: possessive obsession, 얀데레, ヤンデレ. paraphrases: 상대를 감시하고 소유하려는 얀데레; surveillance, control, coercion, and possessiveness; 相手を監視して独占しようとする.

character_response_confounder:tsundere:o.text: Character-response confounder meaning: A brief jealous reaction leaves autonomy, choice, and personal boundaries intact. en label: brief ordinary jealousy with autonomy and boundaries explicitly preserved. ko label: 잠깐 질투하지만 상대의 경계와 선택을 명확히 존중하는 일반 감정. ja label: 一時的に嫉妬しても相手の境界と選択を明確に尊重する一般的な感情. aliases: ordinary jealousy, 일반적인 질투, 普通の嫉妬. paraphrases: 다른 사람을 보고 잠깐 질투하지만 상대의 선택과 경계를 존중한다; brief jealousy with autonomy, choice, and boundaries left intact; 一時的に嫉妬するが相手の選択と境界を尊重する.

character_response_concept:yandere.text: Character-response concept meaning: Sincere affection or devoted care toward one identifiable adult counterpart escalates into a possessive, target-directed action that crosses a personal boundary or appropriates access, followed by an observable consequence for that same counterpart. The affection-control relation and shared target define the concept; no hairstyle, eye color, costume, role, weapon, blood, medical tool, fixed gaze, smile, or diagnosis is required. en label: sincere affection toward one specific adult counterpart escalating into possessive monitoring, boundary intrusion, or access control directed at that same counterpart. ko label: 한 명의 동일한 성인 상대를 향한 진심 어린 애정이 그 상대의 경계를 넘는 소유적 감시나 접근 통제로 번지는 얀데레. ja label: 一人の同じ成人相手への純粋な好意が、その相手の境界を越える独占的な監視やアクセス支配へ発展するヤンデレ. aliases: 얀데레, ヤンデレ, yandere. semantic relations: same relationship target for relationship_target, surface_affect, primary_action, immediate_consequence; trigger precedes or coexists before primary_action; surface_affect contrasts with immediate_consequence. optional manifestations: a bounded mismatch between presentation cues and an observable action without relying on protected-class stereotypes; a visible task, habit, or handling action that supports an authored tendency; the visible event, task, or relationship condition selecting the current action; A slight brow eyelid mouth or jaw change provides the primary human-readable affect cue.; eye, head, and torso orientation toward a visible person or task target without mind-reading claims; gaze, distance, or practical action whose target makes the relationship legible. paraphrases: 같은 성인 상대를 정성껏 돌보지만 그 사람의 출입과 일정을 자기 손에 두려는 행동이 이미 드러난다; 다정한 표정과 헌신은 한 사람에게만 향하고 그 애정이 같은 사람의 사적 경계를 넘는 소유 행동으로 이어진다; 사랑하는 한 명을 위한 과도한 배려가 그 사람의 다른 선택지를 줄이는 결과를 남긴다; Her sincere care for one adult counterpart becomes possessive monitoring of that same person's access and choices.; A tender outward response and one boundary-crossing action point to the same affection target, with the consequence already visible.; Devotion to one identifiable adult turns into nonviolent control rather than generic jealousy or horror styling.; 同じ成人相手への優しい世話が、その人の出入りや予定を自分の管理下に置く行動へ変わる; 一人への愛情表現と、その同じ相手の境界を越える独占行動が同時に見える; 純粋な献身が同じ相手の選択肢を狭めた結果まで画面に残っている.

character_response_confounder:yandere:ge.text: Character-response confounder meaning: Affection and care remain open and prosocial, with no possessive monitoring, boundary intrusion, or access consequence. en label: open romantic devotion that preserves the counterpart's boundaries and choices. ko label: 상대의 경계와 선택을 존중하며 공개적으로 다정한 일반적 헌신. ja label: 相手の境界と選択を尊重する素直で一般的な献身. aliases: generic devotion, 일반적 헌신, 一般的な献身. paraphrases: 사랑하는 상대를 다정하게 돕지만 그 사람의 선택은 그대로 존중한다; openly loving care with no boundary crossing or possessive consequence; 相手の選択を尊重しながら素直に優しく世話をする.

character_response_confounder:yandere:or.text: Character-response confounder meaning: The character feels jealous or insecure, but no concrete possessive action or changed access state is visible. en label: ordinary jealousy or insecurity without a target-directed boundary crossing. ko label: 같은 상대의 경계를 넘는 행동 없이 질투하거나 불안해하는 일반적 감정. ja label: 同じ相手への境界侵入行動を伴わない一般的な嫉妬や不安. aliases: ordinary jealousy, 일반적인 질투, 普通の嫉妬. paraphrases: 다른 사람을 보고 질투하지만 상대의 경계나 선택에는 손대지 않는다; jealous expression without possessive action or consequence; 嫉妬した表情だけで相手の境界には踏み込まない.

character_response_confounder:yandere:ro.text: Character-response confounder meaning: A nurse, caregiver, attendant, or other role performs ordinary duty; costume and tools do not establish obsessive affection. en label: routine professional care or a role portrait with no possessive relationship action. ko label: 소유적 관계 행동 없이 직업적 돌봄이나 역할 소품만 보이는 인물 사진. ja label: 独占的な関係行動がなく職務上のケアや役割小物だけを見せる人物写真. aliases: routine professional care, composed professional with no possessive relationship action, 주사기를 든 일반 간호사, 관계 행동 없는 무표정한 전문가, 注射器を持つ普通の看護師. paraphrases: 간호사가 주사기를 들고 차분하게 환자를 돌보는 일반 의료 장면; 침착하게 혼자 일하지만 특정 상대를 위한 행동은 없는 무표정한 전문가; a nurse holding a syringe in an ordinary clinical portrait; an expressionless expert works alone with no action for a specific counterpart; 看護師が注射器を持って通常のケアをする医療ポートレート.

character_response_confounder:yandere:ho.text: Character-response confounder meaning: Threat styling or pure hostility is visible, but there is no affectionate same-target relationship or possessive boundary consequence. en label: generic horror or pure hostility built from threats, anger, a weapon, blood, red light, or an intense stare. ko label: 애정 대상과 소유 행동 없이 미움 위협 분노 무기 피 붉은 조명 강렬한 시선으로 만든 일반 공포나 순수 적대. ja label: 愛情対象や独占行動がなく憎悪、脅迫、怒り、武器、血、赤い照明、強い視線だけで作る一般的な恐怖や純粋な敵意. aliases: generic horror menace, 일반 공포 인물, 一般的なホラー人物. paraphrases: 칼과 피와 붉은 조명만 있는 무서운 인물 사진; 상대를 미워해서 위협하고 계속 화만 내며 호감은 없다; weapon, blood, and a menacing stare with no affection target; only hatred, threats, and anger toward the target with no sincere affection; 武器と血と怖い視線だけで愛情対象が見えない.

character_response_confounder:yandere:de.text: Character-response confounder meaning: Monitoring is explained by work, investigation, fear, or hostility rather than affection toward the same target. en label: detached surveillance, investigation, or security monitoring with no sincere affection. ko label: 진심 어린 애정 없이 업무나 적대 목적으로 대상을 감시하는 조사 보안 행동. ja label: 純粋な好意がなく業務や敵対目的で対象を監視する調査・警備行動. aliases: detached surveillance, 업무상 감시, 職務上の監視. paraphrases: 보안 요원이 업무상 화면을 감시하지만 개인적 애정은 없다; professional monitoring without devotion to the observed person; 警備担当者が業務で監視するだけで個人的な好意はない.

character_response_confounder:yandere:ts.text: Character-response confounder meaning: A rejecting or guarded surface is contradicted by prosocial care, without possession, surveillance, or boundary control. en label: guarded affection that leaks through care while preserving the counterpart's autonomy. ko label: 퉁명스러운 표면 아래 호감이 돌봄으로 새지만 상대의 자율성은 침범하지 않는 츤데레. ja label: そっけない表面から好意がケアとして漏れるが相手の自律性は侵さないツンデレ. aliases: tsundere guarded affection, 츤데레 돌봄, ツンデレの気遣い. paraphrases: 퉁명스럽게 굴지만 같은 상대를 돕고 선택을 존중한다; guarded care with concealed liking and no possessive control; そっけなく助けながらも相手の選択を尊重する.

character_response_confounder:yandere:co.text: Character-response confounder meaning: A composed person shows strain, tears, or self-regulation difficulty, but no affection-control relationship is established. en label: contained personal distress or a strained social mask without possessive target-directed action. ko label: 소유적 대상 행동 없이 감정 누출과 불안정한 사회적 표면만 보이는 개인적 고통. ja label: 独占的な対象行動がなく感情の漏れと不安定な社会的表面だけが見える個人的苦痛. aliases: contained personal distress, shy or anxious withdrawal, 억눌린 개인적 고통, 수줍은 관계 회피, 부끄러워 말을 못 하고 상대에게서 물러나는 소심한 인물, 抑えた個人的苦痛. paraphrases: 단정한 인물이 눈물을 참지만 특정 애정 대상이나 경계 침범은 없다; 부끄러워 말을 못 하고 상대에게서 물러나는 소심한 인물; a strained composed portrait without a possessive relationship action; a shy person withdraws without possessive action or an affection-control relationship; 整った人物が涙をこらえるだけで特定の愛情対象や境界侵入はない.

character_response_concept:kuudere.text: Character-response concept meaning: A calm, emotionally restrained baseline remains intact around a specific trusted counterpart while positive affiliation becomes observable through one localized softening and one understated, target-directed supportive act with an already-visible consequence for that same counterpart. Stable composure plus selective relational warmth defines the concept; expressionlessness, competence, attractiveness, hair, eyes, costume, role, palette, gaze, pose, or a caring prop alone does not. en label: a calm low-expression baseline that remains stable while one small sign of warmth and a quiet supportive act become visible toward the same trusted counterpart. ko label: 침착하고 감정 표현이 적은 태도를 유지하면서도 같은 신뢰 상대에게 작은 온기와 조용한 돌봄 행동이 드러나는 쿨데레. ja label: 冷静で感情表現の少ない態度を保ちながら、同じ信頼相手への小さな温かさと静かな支援行動が見えるクーデレ. aliases: 쿨데레, 쿠데레, 쿨 데레, クーデレ, kuudere, cooldere, cool-dere. semantic relations: surface_affect contrasts with underlying_affiliation; same relationship target for relationship_target, primary_action, affect_leak, immediate_consequence; trigger precedes or coexists before primary_action. optional manifestations: a visible task, habit, or handling action that supports an authored tendency; A concrete visible act of tending, repairing, supporting, teaching, preparing, or checking another subject or shared task.; A slight brow eyelid mouth or jaw change provides the primary human-readable affect cue.; eye, head, and torso orientation toward a visible person or task target without mind-reading claims; a deliberate separation between displayed response and one restrained leakage cue of underlying positive affect; gaze, distance, or practical action whose target makes the relationship legible; a small context-specific relaxation or care action directed toward an identified trusted counterpart; supportive positioning that preserves consent and autonomy rather than restraining or possessing the counterpart. paraphrases: 늘 담담한 인물이 같은 동료의 젖은 소매를 조용히 정리해 주고 그 동료가 편해진 것을 확인하는 순간에 입매만 아주 조금 풀린다; 차분한 태도는 그대로지만 신뢰하는 한 사람을 위한 실용적인 도움과 국소적인 온기가 같은 장면에서 드러난다; 모두에게 감정 표현이 적은 성인이 특정 상대에게 필요한 물건을 먼저 건네고 그 상대가 안도하는 동안 눈가만 부드러워진다; Her composed low-expression baseline stays intact while she quietly solves one practical problem for the same trusted counterpart and only one facial area softens.; A restrained adult character shows selective warmth through a small same-target act whose helpful result is already visible, without hostility or a personality switch.; 冷静な低反応のまま、同じ信頼相手を静かに助け、その相手の安心が見える瞬間だけ口元がわずかに和らぐ; 平静さを崩さず、特定の相手にだけ小さな気遣いと局所的な温かさが現れる.

character_response_confounder:kuudere:ge.text: Character-response confounder meaning: A person looks calm, serious, competent, or expressionless, but no trusted counterpart receives a selective supportive act or visible benefit. en label: generic stoicism with no relationship-specific warmth or supportive consequence. ko label: 특정 상대를 향한 온기나 돌봄 결과 없이 그저 무표정하고 침착한 일반적 과묵함. ja label: 特定の相手への温かさや支援結果がなく、ただ無表情で冷静な一般的ストイックさ. aliases: generic stoicism, 일반적 과묵함, 一般的な無表情. paraphrases: 침착하게 혼자 일하지만 특정 상대를 위한 행동은 없다; a composed professional portrait with no relationship-specific care; 冷静に一人で作業するだけで特定相手への気遣いはない.

character_response_confounder:kuudere:da.text: Character-response confounder meaning: Low expression comes from timidity, anxiety, or avoidance, without the stable composed baseline and quiet follow-through that distinguish kuudere. en label: shy or anxious withdrawal whose reserve is caused by social inhibition. ko label: 통제된 침착함이 아니라 수줍음이나 불안 때문에 관계에서 물러나는 단데레식 회피. ja label: 制御された平静さではなく、恥ずかしさや不安から関係を避けるダンデレ的な引きこもり. aliases: dandere shy withdrawal, 수줍은 회피, ダンデレ的回避. paraphrases: 부끄러워 말을 못 하고 상대에게서 물러난다; timid avoidance with no calm practical follow-through; 恥ずかしくて相手を避けるだけで静かな支援行動はない.

character_response_confounder:kuudere:ts.text: Character-response confounder meaning: The outward response actively rejects, protests, or becomes flustered before care leaks through, rather than preserving a calm low-expression surface. en label: hostile, rejecting, or flustered denial contradicted by hidden care. ko label: 침착한 표면을 유지하는 대신 퉁명스러운 거절이나 동요로 호감을 부정하는 츤데레. ja label: 平静さを保つのではなく、拒絶や動揺で好意を否定するツンデレ. aliases: tsundere hostile denial, denying she cares while helping the same person, 퉁명스러운 호감 부정, ツンデレの拒絶. paraphrases: 신경 쓰지 않는다며 상대를 밀어낸 뒤 몰래 돕는다; She keeps helping the same person while denying she cares.; rejecting protest followed by concealed care; 気にしていないと突き放した後で隠れて助ける.

character_response_confounder:kuudere:ge.text: Character-response confounder meaning: Warmth is openly and broadly displayed from the start, so there is no stable low-expression baseline or selective small softening. en label: open, high-amplitude affection expressed similarly toward everyone. ko label: 선택적이고 절제된 온기 대신 누구에게나 크고 공개적으로 표현하는 일반적 다정함. ja label: 選択的で控えめな温かさではなく、誰にでも大きく素直に示す一般的な愛情. aliases: generic open affection, 공개적인 다정함, 素直で開放的な愛情. paraphrases: 처음부터 누구에게나 활짝 웃으며 애정을 표현한다; broad open warmth with no restrained baseline; 最初から誰にでも笑顔で好意を示す.

character_response_confounder:kuudere:ro.text: Character-response confounder meaning: A helpful act is ordinary job performance and shows no selective change, localized warmth, or same-target relational consequence. en label: routine professional service fully explained by role duty. ko label: 관계별 온기가 아니라 직업적 의무만으로 설명되는 일상 서비스. ja label: 関係ごとの温かさではなく職務上の義務だけで説明できる日常サービス. aliases: role-only service, 직업적 서비스, 職務上のサービス. paraphrases: 직원으로서 모든 손님에게 같은 서비스를 제공한다; routine duty performed identically for every client; 職員として全員に同じサービスを行う.

character_response_confounder:kuudere:em.text: Character-response confounder meaning: The subject has no readable affective response or affiliation; a blank face alone is not the restrained warmth pattern. en label: emotionless or nonhuman flatness with no observable positive affiliation. ko label: 신뢰 상대를 향한 긍정적 정서가 보이지 않는 감정 부재나 비인간적 평탄함. ja label: 信頼相手への肯定的な感情が見えない無感情または非人間的な平板さ. aliases: emotionless flatness, 감정 부재, 無感情な平板さ. paraphrases: 표정도 관계 반응도 전혀 없는 인물; a blank affectless subject with no caring response; 表情も関係反応もまったくない人物.

character_response_confounder:kuudere:ya.text: Character-response confounder meaning: Affection narrows the counterpart's autonomy or crosses a boundary, replacing the quiet prosocial care and preserved choice required here. en label: possessive affection expressed through surveillance, control, coercion, or boundary intrusion. ko label: 조용한 돌봄이 아니라 감시 통제 강요나 경계 침범으로 드러나는 얀데레식 소유. ja label: 静かな支援ではなく監視、支配、強要、境界侵入として現れるヤンデレ的独占. aliases: yandere possessive control, 얀데레식 통제, ヤンデレ的支配. paraphrases: 상대를 아낀다며 출입과 일정을 통제한다; possessive monitoring that reduces the counterpart's choices; 相手を思うと言いながら出入りや予定を支配する.
